title: StatusEvent (proposal, v0.2 spike — not authoritative until moved into src/shared/protocol.ts + validate.ts)
description: What the daemon's status reducer consumes after an ingress adapter has normalised a CLI's native payload. Built by the daemon only; never accepted from a client or a CLI as-is.

sessionId.description: AI Term session UUID, resolved by the daemon from the per-session credential header. Never taken from the payload (Claude's session_id / Codex's thread-id are different ids).

source.description: terminal = signals the daemon's own mirror parses from the PTY bytes (OSC 9, bare BEL, OSC 0/2 title).

ts.description: Daemon receive time. CLI clocks are never trusted.

seq.description: Per-session monotonic counter assigned by the daemon; the reducer ignores anything older than the last applied seq.

detail.description: Short, sanitized label only: tool name, notification_type, StopFailure error enum, signal kind. Never prompt text, tool_input, last_assistant_message or file content.

ctxPercent.description: Context USED, 0–100. Present only on context-updated; null when the source can't say.

native.description: Source event name for debugging, e.g. 'Notification:permission_prompt', 'agent-turn-complete', 'osc9'. Not used for decisions.
